HighscoreEntry.title: HighscoreEntry
HighscoreEntry.description: A player's best public highscore for a Wortwelten game mode.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Authentication UID (anonymous or Google) of the score owner

playerName.description: Player profile display name shown on the leaderboard

game.description: Game identifier for the score entry

isPublic.description: Marks the highscore entry as visible on the public leaderboard

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score entry was first created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score entry was last updated

BaseVocabularyWord.title: BaseVocabularyWord
BaseVocabularyWord.description: A centrally managed online base vocabulary pair shared across all Wortwelten players.

isActive.description: Whether the base vocabulary word is active and publicly readable

updatedBy.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the admin who created or last edited the word

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was last updated

/highscores/{scoreId}.description: Public highscores keyed by {ownerUid}_{game}_{profileSlug} so each browser profile stores its own best score per game without requiring Google login.

/baseVocabulary/{wordId}.description: Centrally managed base vocabulary words readable by all clients and writable only by the verified admin.
